{{Top|leg|title=x2-100 laser cannon}}
The '''x2-100 laser cannon''' was a cheap and powerful [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] manufactured by [[Sund]]. It was frequently used with [[T-47 airspeeder/Legends|T-47 airspeeders]] and favored by outlaws.
